item.title: Kalen DeBoer gives update on Dre Kirkpatrick Jr.’s status with the team after missing Texas A&M game
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Kalen DeBoer gives an update on Dre Kirkpatrick Jr.’s status with the team.
Kirkpatrick was ruled out for Alabama’s game with Texas A&M on Saturday after he was suspended for a violation of team rules, per a UA spokesperson.
Kirkpatrick has been a key contributor in the secondary this season and is the son of former Alabama All-American and national champion whose name he shares.
🎥: Nick Kelly
#alabamafootball #rolltide #rtr #alabama #collegefootball
